name: 49690 · Williamsburg, MI
findings: ZIP 49690 (Williamsburg) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49690 (Williamsburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49690 (Williamsburg) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
